description: Five real top-level CASE lifecycle scenarios with and without the active-task supplement skill.

evals.name: Planning defers execution
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Design, review, and confirm CASE for the planning full task. Produce and review a valid CASE, then stop. Do not implement code. Report the task path, caseHash, status, and whether any result exists.
evals.expected_output: A valid confirmed CASE for the planning task, no execution result, and status remains planning.
assertions: case.md passes workloom_task_case review before confirmation.
The confirmed caseHash matches the current CASE bytes.
The task remains planning and no case-result.md exists.
No implementation file is created or modified.
A real check executor is dispatched with purpose=case-design and a recorded case.designSession.
The transcript waits for explicit user approval before calling confirm.

evals.name: Ready execution and fingerprint revalidation
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Design and review CASE for the in_progress full task whose implement report is complete. The initial request is not an approval: stop after review and wait for a new user message that approves the current caseHash before any confirm or execution. After that approval, execute the CASE and record real coverage. Then repeat the same CASE request without changing code. Finally change an untracked source file and repeat it again. After that, make a small CASE edit without re-confirming and show that execution waits for a new review and approval. Save this phase as outputs/case-edit.txt. Report fingerprints and session ids.
evals.expected_output: A fully executed CASE, a no-op second run with unchanged fingerprint, a fresh execution after the untracked file changes, and no execution after an unapproved CASE edit.
assertions: case-result.md records passed SR/C items, real coverage, and codeFingerprint=<64-hex>.
The second run reuses the valid result and creates no new child session.
Changing an untracked source file changes the fingerprint and triggers re-execution.
Editing case.md changes the review hash and prevents a new execution dispatch until fresh approval.
The final check and case.result match the current RESULT bytes.
The transcript stops after CASE review and waits for an independent user approval message before any confirm or execution dispatch.

evals.name: Legacy migration and execution
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Design and execute CASE on the in_progress legacy full task with no case field and design.md + implement.md. Migrate the plan first if required, then design and review CASE. The initial request is not an approval: stop after review and wait for a new user message that approves the current caseHash before any confirm or execution. After that approval, execute the CASE and record real evidence. Report the old and new case records.
evals.expected_output: The legacy task gains a valid plan when needed, a confirmed CASE, required=true, and a valid result with a linked execution session.
assertions: Legacy design.md + implement.md are handled by workloom-migrate-plan before CASE design when plan.md is absent.
Confirm changes case.required to true without deleting legacy audit fields.
case-result.md checkSession equals designSession or is connected by a valid fallbackOf chain.
Real CASE evidence and coverage or a justified not_applicable result exist.
The transcript stops after CASE review and waits for an independent user approval message before any confirm or execution dispatch.

evals.name: Batch uses one confirmation
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. With no active task, process CASE for every eligible candidate. Review all CASE artifacts, present one batch approval request, then confirm and execute them serially after approval. Report the batch file and per-task states.
evals.expected_output: One batch file contains both task paths and distinct caseHash values; one user approval covers both, and execution follows the listed order.
assertions: .workloom/workspace/case-batches/<batch-id>.md contains both task paths, distinct hashes, approval time, and execution states.
One approval covers the listed batch; each confirm uses its own current hash.
Execution is serial and preserves one active task at a time.
Any non-ready CASE is excluded from the batch and reported.
Light, completed, archived, and non-ready candidate directories remain byte-identical.

evals.name: Blocked case stops the batch
evals.prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. Process CASE for the batch whose first task has a blocked runtime case. Review all CASE artifacts. The initial request is not an approval: stop after review and wait for a new user message that approves the listed caseHashes before any confirm or execution. Report completed, blocked, and untouched tasks and update the batch file.
evals.expected_output: The first task is blocked, later tasks are not executed, and the batch file records those exact states without a pass credential.
assertions: The blocked C item prevents a check pass and cannot be bypassed with force.
No later task starts CASE execution after the blocked first result.
The batch file lists completed, blocked, and untouched states accurately.
The main report identifies the blocked task and all tasks left unexecuted.
The transcript stops after batch review and waits for an independent user approval message before any confirm or execution dispatch.
